test_paradigm: Rust, per .claude/rules/testing.md. Every acceptance body is PRE-AUTHORED by DISTILL (feature-delta.md DISTILL sections, distill/red-classification.md); crafters only remove the #[should_panic] marker (or the #![cfg(any())] gate plus its distill-pending-owner-api marker) of the tests the step names, run the body unchanged, confirm the semantic RED before changing production code, implement to the pinned contract (feature-delta.md Interface contracts, ADR-0344..0347) and confirm GREEN. Crafters never write, replace, weaken or complete an acceptance body and never invent public API: a missing shape is a blocker surfaced to the orchestrator (CLAUDE.md 'Implement to the design'). Sanctioned edits to existing non-pending tests: the compiler-enumerated mechanical renames and literal rewrites the single-cut changes force (for_allocation -> for_workload, Backend.alloc -> Backend.workload_identity, IssuedCertificateRow literals gaining issued_for) and the non-mechanical re-shapes of feature-delta.md 'Non-mechanical' items 1-6 that DISTILL already performed or lists for DELIVER. Greenfield single cut (DD-5): no shim, no alias, no parser of the old /alloc/ shape survives. Every command runs on the metal box (cargo xtask metal run -- ...), never Lima, never --exclusive for tests; no kvm-tests/native_launcher test is added (S-PIG-71 and the mtls-relay equivalence tests are existing guest-placed tests run by the same lane). Mutation testing is DISABLED (CLAUDE.md): no mutation scope in any step. No roadmap step id or issue number in any new identifier, filename or log message (.claude/rules/domain-naming.md). Validator length warnings are cosmetic.
